title: SPF 30A
meta_description: SPF 30A is a stylish three-story beach retreat in Santa Rosa Beach, offering a large private pool, multiple balconies, and a short walk to Gulfview Heights Beach Access. With five bedrooms, four bathrooms, and space for up to fifteen guests, this pet-friendly 30A vacation home is ideal for families and groups seeking comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Enjoy open-concept
description_expanded: AboutSPF 30A – A Stylish 30A Retreat with Private Pool, Multiple Balconies, and a Short Walk to the Beach Santa Rosa Beach | 5 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms | Sleeps 15 | Pet-Friendly | Private Pool | Multiple Balconies | Walk to Beach Access Why Guests Love SPF 30A: • Large private pool with furnished patio for lounging and dining • Short walk to Gulfview Heights Beach Access • Multiple balconies offering serene spaces for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, and peaceful views of the private pool • Complimentary bikes included for exploring 30A’s scenic paths and local hotspots • Golf cart perk: Add a street-legal golf cart to your stay and enjoy exclusive savings off the golf cart rental • Open concept living, dining, and kitchen filled with natural light • Spacious three-story layout ideal for families and multi-generational groups • Bright coastal décor and modern finishes throughout • Games and cards included for laid-back entertainment after a day at the beach • Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops • Several flexible sleeping spaces including bunk rooms and a sleeper sofa • Two luxurious third-floor king suites with private balconies and ensuite baths • First-floor bedrooms with easy access to the pool deck • Outdoor shower for quick beach clean-up • Enjoy grilling poolside with a convenient outdoor grill • Two refrigerators, providing plenty of space for groceries, drinks, and beach-day snacks • Walkable location near incredible dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment • Scenic 30A bike paths nearby for exploring beach towns and coastal dunes • Pet-friendly home and fenced backyard, creating a comfortable space for your furry family members to enjoy • Peaceful corner lot offering privacy and added outdoor space • Professionally managed with thoughtful amenities for a relaxing stay • Starter amenities including Starbucks coffee and bottled waters • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Four parking spaces Your Private Beach Retreat Awaits Welcome to SPF 30A, a bright and spacious three-story beach vacation home tucked just off Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach. Perfectly situated on a prime corner lot and only a short stroll from Gulfview Heights Beach Access, this five-bedroom 30A vacation home invites you to embrace the laid-back luxury of Florida's Emerald Coast. With a large private pool, airy interiors, multiple balconies, and an incredibly convenient location, SPF 30A is ideal for families, friend groups, and travelers seeking sun, style, and relaxation. Open Concept Living Designed for Connection The entire second floor serves as the main gathering hub, where walls of windows fill the open living, dining, and kitchen areas with warm natural light. Relax on plush seating after a day at the beach, enjoy family meals at the large dining table, or step out onto the balcony to feel the Gulf breeze drift through the treetops. The fully stocked kitchen includes: • Stainless steel appliances • Granite countertops • Breakfast bar seating • All cookware, serveware, and essentials for preparing meals • Spices Whether hosting a family feast or grabbing a quick bite before the beach, this space is built for convenience and comfort. Bedrooms on Every Floor for Privacy and Flexibility First Floor A fantastic setup for families, early risers, or guests wanting easy pool access: • King bedroom with patio access • Bunk room with two twin bunk beds and a sleeper sofa • Hall bathroom with tub and shower combo Guests can step directly from the bedrooms into the fenced backyard and private pool area. Second Floor • Bunk room with twin over full bunk • Hall bathroom with tub and shower combo • Living room queen sleeper sofa for additional accommodations • Convenient laundry room with full-size washer and dryer Third Floor – Two Private King Suites The entire top level is reserved for comfort and relaxation with: • Two spacious king bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom • Beautiful balcony access from both suites • Peaceful views and elevated privacy Perfect for couples or grandparents seeking a bit more luxury. Outdoor Living at Its Best Your private pool sparkles beneath the Florida sunshine, offering a refreshing retreat after beach days or bike rides. Enjoy: • Furnished patio with lounge seating • Outdoor dining area • Outdoor shower for sandy feet • Covered and open balconies for unwinding throughout the day SPF 30A makes it easy to enjoy the outdoors from sunrise to sunset. Walk to Dining, Coffee Shops, Markets, and Live Music This home is surrounded by some of 30A’s best local gems. Walk to: • Gulfview Snack Shack for casual beachside bites • Goatfeathers Seafood Market and Grill for fresh Gulf seafood • Local Catch Bar and Grill for live music and great food Bike to: • Gulf Place Town Center • Coffee shops, boutiques, art galleries, and more • Scenic 30A’s iconic beach communities Whether strolling the shoreline, enjoying seafood al fresco, or exploring 30A on bikes, SPF 30A keeps you close to everything. Floor Plan Overview First Floor: King bedroom, bunk room (two twin bunks), hall bath, patio and pool access Second Floor: Living room with queen sleeper sofa and balcony access, dining, kitchen, bunk room (full over twin), hall bath, laundry Third Floor: King primary bedroom with ensuite and balcony, second king suite with ensuite and balcony Your Perfect 30A Vacation Starts at SPF 30A With its unbeatable walkability, large private pool, bright open living spaces, and flexible bedroom layout, SPF 30A offers everything you need for a memorable Emerald Coast escape. Relax, recharge, and reconnect in a home designed for effortless coastal living.
